description:
Following his acclaimed 2014 release, CHURCH, avant garde Pianist, DJ, and Producer Mark de Clive­Lowe delivers CHURCH REMIXED. The album is re­envisioned through the ears of producers from all over the world ­ the UK, New Zealand, Angola, Sweden, South Africa and more. 

CHURCH REMIXED features the talents of AtJazz, Opolopo, Daz I­Kue (Bugz in the Attic), Myele Manzanza and more creating dancefloor and head­nod gems ­ from hip hop to deep house, and afro dubs to electro funk.

New Zealand's Leonard Charles remixes 'The Processional' adding a powerhouse trio of NZ vocal talent to his downtempo refix ­ Ruby Walsh, Mara TK (Electric Wire Hustle) and Kimbra! The MdCL classic instrumental 'Brukstep' gets the deep jazzy flavors of a classic AtJazz Astro remix. Nia Andrews' vocal tracks get reconfigured for the dancefloor by Opolopo ('Now or Never'), Brian Keys Tharme ('Hollow') and QB Smith ('Hollow').
